# FigixNote vault — AI agent guide

This folder is a FigixNote note vault, edited by both the FigixNote app and,
optionally, AI coding agents working directly on the files.

## Layout

- `INDEX.md` — every note's title, folder, and last-updated time.
  Regenerated automatically whenever the app lists or saves notes — don't
  hand-edit it.
- `note_<uuid>/` — one folder per note. A note can have multiple pages
  (`pages.json` + `pages/*.md`); each folder carries its own `AGENTS.md` /
  `CLAUDE.md` explaining that layout and the footnote-media convention its
  pages use. Read that before editing anything inside.
- `AGENTS.md` / `CLAUDE.md` (this file) — regenerated by the app; edits are
  overwritten.

## Working with a note

1. Look up the note in `INDEX.md` to get its folder name.
2. Open `note_<uuid>/AGENTS.md` and read it before touching any page or
   anything else in that folder.
